description: User-agent threat check — Classify a User-Agent string for bot defense and WAF rules: attack and scan tools (sqlmap, nuclei, nikto, masscan, zgrab, ffuf, wpscan...), internet-wide research scanners (Censys, Shodan, Expanse...), AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Bytespider...), search engines, SEO crawlers, link-preview bots, uptime monitors and scripted HTTP clients, plus exploit payloads hidden in the header (Log4Shell ${jndi:, Shellshock, SQLi, XSS, traversal) and anomalies (empty, malformed, stale or forged browser versions, impossible platforms). Returns verdict BLOCK/CHALLENGE/POLICY/ALLOW/REVIEW, risk score 0-100, matches and browser/OS. Pass ua= (or self=1 to check the caller's own header). Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_ua_check
